issuing_body: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST)
enforcement_authorities: NIST Information Technology Laboratory (ITL) AI Program
implementation_notes: The AI RMF is explicitly intended for voluntary use. A companion Playbook, Roadmap, and Crosswalk have been published. A Generative AI Profile (NIST-AI-600-1) was released July 26, 2024. A concept note for a Critical Infrastructure Profile was released April 7, 2026. The Trustworthy and Responsible AI Resource Center was launched March 30, 2023 to facilitate implementation.
